notes: Single-page app with four screens driven by state.screen: 'path' (landing: hero + track picker + 'what you get'), 'intake' (lead form), 'q' (questions), 'res' (results). Full question bank, scoring and PDF text are in forms.json → assessment.

sections.heading: Is your organization ready to build?
sections.headingHtml: Is your organization ready to build?
sections.lede: Answer eight questions in about four minutes. You get a readiness score, a breakdown by area, and an action plan in order, as a PDF you can share with your team.

sections.lede: Your results show up on screen as soon as you finish, and the PDF is yours to keep.

cards.title: Score and tier
cards.body: A readiness score out of 100 and a tier: Foundation, Growth Ready, or Premier.

cards.title: Five areas
cards.body: Space, infrastructure, funding, program, and timeline, each marked strong, developing, or a gap.

cards.title: Action plan
cards.body: Next steps ranked by how much each one moves your readiness.

cards.title: Two-page PDF
cards.body: Download it from the results page and pass it to your team or board.

body: Rather talk it through first? The consultation is free.

sections.heading: Who is this report for?
body: Your results appear as soon as you finish, with a PDF you can download. Someone from TANCHES.GG may follow up to walk you through them.
sections.formNote: By continuing, you agree to our Terms & Privacy Policy.
errors: Add your name and a valid email to start.

sections.hint: Pick the answer that fits best. You can go back at any time.

interactive.behaviour: Picking an option records it, then after 220 ms auto-advances; after the last question a reference is generated and the results screen is shown. Back goes to the previous question, or to the intake screen from question 1. Segmented progress bar: current = is-on, answered = is-done.

cards.title: Hardware is one part of the ecosystem.
cards.body: A program that lasts needs more than PCs: facility design, network and cybersecurity, hardware, the program itself, competition in the TANCHES.GG League, and support long after launch. We design, build, and run every piece together with Dell, Lenovo, and other leading manufacturers, and one team is accountable for all of it.
